The affix छण् comes in the sense of 'enounced by him' after the words 1. तित्तिरि 2. वरतन्तु 3. खण्डिक and 4. उख।

Terms: छण्

An affix having an indicatory त् , is स्वरित i.e. has circumflex accent.

Terms: accent-विभक्ति

The इट् augment is not taken by the following कृत् affixes - 1. ति 2. तु 3. त्र 4. त 5. थ 6. सि 7. सु 8. सर 9. क and 10. स।

Terms: इट् augment
